text: RAMS Global, which works through RAMS Kazakhstan and RAMS Türkiye mainly in construction and real estate, was founded in Kazakhstan in 1995 by Ramazan Bülbül, who owns it and runs it with his three sons.
short: RAMS Global is owned by its founder, Ramazan Bülbül.

source.name: NTV: Rams Global'in sahibi Ramazan Bülbül kimdir, ne iş yapar? Galatasaray'ın yeni stat isim sponsoru Rams Global oldu
source.quote: Rams Global’in sahibi Ramazan Bülbül, dev şirketi üç oğlu ile birlikte yönetiyor.
